notes.title: Project-Venus.RP Will be released on the 27th of August
notes.content:
[h2]We had labored hard for more than a month to produce the content within the game. 

For this work, we had tried to keep it new by introducing a new way of playing it, and we hope you would like it. [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40855133/0d0c6be40f9eec2f477aaece1e3de34b069fe3fc.png[/img][h2]Thank you for playing![/h2]
